en.headline: Tuen Mun water supply restored after emergency pipe repair
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department completed urgent works on a 600mm main near Tuen Lee Street, restoring service to Villa Tiara, Hin Fat Estate and nearby estates from 9.30am.
body: The Water Supplies Department said emergency repairs to a leaking 600-millimetre steel fresh-water main on Castle Peak Road near Tuen Lee Street in Tuen Mun had been completed, with potable water supply to Villa Tiara, Hin Fat Estate, Handsome Court and Alpine Garden restored progressively from 9.30am on Tuesday.

The department stated that the overnight shutdown caused only limited inconvenience because most buildings have internal storage tanks. Temporary supply points, including two water tankers and more than 30 static tanks, were set up near the affected estates, and only a small number of residents needed to use them.

The same section of pipe had leaked earlier this week. The department said it would incorporate the stretch into its risk-based improvement programme and aim to start replacement works by the end of the year after coordinating with relevant departments and estate management.

zh.headline: 屯門水管搶修完成 怡峰園等屋苑供水恢復
zh.dek: 水務署完成青山公路近屯利街600毫米食水鋼管緊急維修，怡峰園、顯發邨、恆順園及冠峰園今早9時半起陸續恢復供水。
body: 水務署表示，屯門青山公路近屯利街一條直徑600毫米食水鋼水管的緊急維修工程已完成，怡峰園、顯發邨、恆順園及冠峰園的食水供應於星期二早上9時半起陸續恢復正常。
署方指，由於相關大廈設有內部儲水缸作緩衝，停水期間僅有零星住戶需要到臨時供水點取水。署方已於受影響屋苑附近設立超過10個臨時供水點，並調派兩架水車及超過30個水箱，確保臨時供水充足。
涉事喉管本星期較早前曾出現滲漏。水務署表示，已將該段喉管納入風險為本水管改善工程，並會與相關部門及持份者緊密協調，爭取於今年底展開更換工程。
